title: Trimming palm trees in San Diego
description:
Though the City’s Urban Forestry program doesn’t plant palms, our team maintains more than 43,000 palm trees that currently exist across our neighborhoods. With appropriate funding, palms are pruned every two years to ensure the public's safety in the city right-of-way, and to support the health of the trees. 

Our tree maintenance teams will be servicing many neighborhoods throughout the city for Fiscal Year 2027, including Barrio Logan, Paradise Hills, University Heights, Encanto and North Park. To learn more about how we care for our urban forest, or to see our FY2027 palm tree pruning cycle schedule, visit: sandiego.gov/trees/maintenance.
